commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
echo LISTEN_BIND
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo SS_OUT_BEGIN
  ss -tulpn 2>/dev/null | grep -iE ':8443|:24443|python3' || echo SS_NO_MATCH
  echo SS_OUT_END
else
  echo SS_NOT_PRESENT
fi
echo PYTHON_PROC
ps -eo pid,args --width 300 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'ragin.server_v2|server_v2.py|python3.*server_v2' | grep -v grep | head -n 20 || true
echo PORT_DOC
if [ -f /etc/ragin/server.env ]; then
  echo ENV_PORT=$(grep -E '^PORT=' /etc/ragin/server.env 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || echo ENV_PORT_MISSING)
  echo ENV_BIND=$(grep -E '^RAGIN_BIND_HOST=' /etc/ragin/server.env 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || echo ENV_BIND_MISSING)
  echo ENV_MTLS=$(grep -E '^RAGIN_MTLS' /etc/ragin/server.env 2>/dev/null | head -n 40 || echo ENV_MTLS_MISSING)
else
  echo ENV_MISSING=/etc/ragin/server.env
fi
echo DONE
